Answer ID: 15401 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1534/1257=D1430) In Bahishti Zewar part 9, there are some tawiz for conception and protection of foetus, get it made by someone accordingly. Recite the following dua /verse after every salah: رب ھ ب لی من لدنک ذریۃ طیبۃ انک سمیع الدعاء Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
